title: U.S. Nuclear Atlas
source_method: Hand-transcribed and validated from the cited EIA table and IAEA Table 14; locations rounded to 0.001 degrees.
scope: Operating commercial electricity-generating reactors in the 2024 reference fleet. Excludes retired, suspended/out-of-service, proposed, under-construction and research reactors. No live outage or restart tracking.

capacity.title: EIA — U.S. Nuclear Reactors and Reactor Capacity
capacity.note: 2024 net summer electrical capacity, released July 31, 2025. Integer MW(e) as published. This series was subsequently discontinued.

commissioning.title: IAEA — Nuclear Power Reactors in the World, 2025 edition
commissioning.note: Table 14, printed pages 43–47 (PDF pages 50–54). Commercial operation month/year, not first grid connection. Includes reactor types and operational roster as of December 31, 2024.

coordinates.title: Explore Nuclear — U.S. site coordinates
coordinates.note: Approximate public site coordinates only, rounded to three decimal degrees. Its operational dates, reactor counts and status descriptions were NOT used.

fleet.title: EIA — U.S. nuclear plant fleet FAQ
fleet.note: 54 operating plants, 94 reactors. The map is a fixed 2024 capacity snapshot, not a live fleet or restart-status feed.
